_comment: Shared contract for resolving a user-facing ticker into the symbols a provider might use.
Two implementations encode this: backend/quotes.py (requests the quote) and
quoteTickerAliases in app.js (matches the returned quote back onto the asset). They are NOT
required to produce the same list — each provider spells exchanges its own way — but every
case below must appear in both, or a symbol fixed on one side silently stays broken on the
other. tests/test_ticker_alias_spec.py and frontend_tests/ticker-alias-spec.test.js read this
same file, so a new case is added once.

cases.why: Users type the brand; the exchange lists the old ticker.
A PLN holding must reach the Warsaw listing, not the US-listed fund of the same name.
Broker exports use the .PL suffix; providers want the bare root too.
A EUR holding should resolve on Xetra before the US line.
A plain US symbol must always be tried as written.
Broker exports suffix US tickers; the bare form has to be reachable.
